title: Boeing F/A-18E Super Hornet (Asobo)
sources: Cockpit input events enumerated from MSFS 11.0.282174.999 (SimConnect EnumerateInputEvents)

entries.name: ENGINE_Starter_Ignition_1
entries.note: Verified on an F/A-18E (APU running): the engine crank switch: set 0 cranks engine 1 (left), set 2 cranks engine 2 (right) ((A:GENERAL ENG STARTER:n) = 1, N2 rises about 4 % a second), set 1 is the centre (off). Both engines were started with it.

entries.name: ENGINE_Throttle_1_Afterburner
entries.note: Verified on an F/A-18E (engines off, read back with the event itself): set 1 switches the afterburner of the left engine on and sets the throttle to (L:XMLVAR_LastAB1ThrottleSet), a fraction that is 0 until the game's own throttle has been used, so with 0 the throttle falls to the idle gate instead. Set that L: variable to 1 first (the throttle then goes to 100 % and values up to 1 are accepted), wait about 100 ms, then set the event to 1. It is refused below military power (throttle 0.8). Set 0 switches it off and leaves the throttle where it was: send the throttle value again.

entries.name: ENGINE_Throttle_1_STOP
entries.note: Verified on an F/A-18E (read from the sim's throttle template and run on the aircraft): the fuel cut-off of the left engine. Set 1 is refused unless the throttle (ENGINE_Throttle_1) is at exactly 0, and a throttle set to 0 from higher up stops at the idle gate first, so the sequence is: throttle 0, wait about 50 ms, throttle 0 again, wait, STOP 1. It then reads 1 and closes the fuel valve ((A:FUELSYSTEM VALVE SWITCH:7) = 0). Any later throttle value clears it by itself (STOP reads 0, the valve reopens); set 0 reopens the valve too.

entries.name: ENGINE_Throttle_1
entries.note: Verified on an F/A-18E: the value is the lever position as a fraction: 0.5 puts the lever at 50 %, 1 or more at 80 % (the military-power stop; afterburner is its own event), a 0 from a higher position stops at the idle gate (10 %, the value then reads 9.99756); only a second 0 (sent about 50 ms later) takes the lever to 0 (the off stop), and 0.1 from the stop puts it back at the idle gate. Any throttle value also clears the cut-off (STOP) and reopens the fuel valve. Light-off at 12 % N2 needs the lever at idle ((A:GENERAL ENG THROTTLE LEVER POSITION:1)).
